Our church gave, and our bishop taught giving: Cyprian wrote a whole treatise on almsgiving, and much of it speaks to believers who had money [[lpc.witness.almsgiving-quenches-sin]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Cyprian told them plainly that their wealth was for sharing their gains with Christ [[lpc.witness.almsgiving-quenches-sin]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Almsgiving was the ordinary remedy for the sin a person goes on committing after baptism [[lpc.witness.almsgiving-quenches-sin]] [[as:paraphrase]].

In the plague, Pontius says, Cyprian preached love of enemies, and help reached beyond believers [[lpc.story.the-plague-and-the-enemies]] [[as:paraphrase]].

sentences.sentence: Almsgiving was the ordinary remedy for the sin a person goes on committing after baptism.
Our sayings tell of the ransom of our captive brethren:
Eight bishops wrote to Cyprian, who led our church, that barbarians had carried off our brothers and sisters, and he read their letter with tears.
He answered that we must pay to set them free, not only out of love but because our religion called us to it.
Paul says that everyone baptized into Christ has put on Christ, so we were to see Christ himself in our captive brothers and sisters.
Our clergy and people gave quickly and freely.
We sent the bishops one hundred thousand sesterces to use for the captives as carefully as they could.

shipped_by_net:
Our church gave, and our bishop taught giving: Cyprian wrote a whole treatise on almsgiving, and much of it speaks to believers who had money. Cyprian told them plainly that their wealth was for sharing their gains with Christ. Almsgiving was the ordinary remedy for the sin a person goes on committing after baptism.

Our sayings tell of the ransom of our captive brethren:

Eight bishops wrote to Cyprian, who led our church, that barbarians had carried off our brothers and sisters, and he read their letter with tears.

He answered that we must pay to set them free, not only out of love but because our religion called us to it. Paul says that everyone baptized into Christ has put on Christ, so we were to see Christ himself in our captive brothers and sisters.

Our clergy and people gave quickly and freely. We sent the bishops one hundred thousand sesterces to use for the captives as carefully as they could.
